subject: mathematics
concept: Comparing fractions with the same denominator (more parts shaded = bigger fraction)
source_inspiration: adapted from Singapore CPA sequencing principles — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student stacks equal-sized fraction tiles to see which covers more area
exercise.pictorial: Student compares two bar models (e.g. 2/4 vs 3/4) and circles the larger
exercise.abstract: Student uses > < = to compare two same-denominator fractions

misconception_flags: assumes larger denominator number always means bigger fraction
